evidence.name: Screen field: Slide extra line
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Slide extra line" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Slide extra line
sections.description: A third text line below the supporting line, available only with the Image + Title + 2 Subtitles template. Use it sparingly for one last small detail like a disclaimer or extra proof, since four text layers over an image quickly overcrowd a slide and slow reading. Supports @variable personalization, countdown timers, and styled chips, and is edited per language.
